name: SmartMore
short_description: In the crowded field of artificial intelligence, SmartMore differentiates by solving one problem end-to-end — a model-serving or evaluation platform — instead of stacking horizontal features.

why_relevant: For Algeria, the transferable piece is the process, not the product: a team that learns how to build artificial intelligence products can serve regional markets from Algiers at a fraction of the cost of Western hubs.
